source.title: Algebraic Geometry, Commutative Algebra and Combinatorics: Interactions and Open Problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 7620546. Local shell fetching could not resolve zbmath.org or api.zbmath.org, so curl-based download was unavailable in this sandbox. Local resolver rows in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv and outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identify the same work as 'Algebraic geometry, commutative algebra and combinatorics: interactions and open problems', DOI 10.1007/978-3-030-89694-2_14, published in 2021.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted / metadata_only, with local network_or_dns_failure for direct shell fetches. The DOI resolves to the Springer chapter landing page at https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-030-89694-2_14, which confirms the title, author, pages 445-473, abstract, and references but marks the chapter as subscription preview content and offers paid chapter PDF access rather than readable full text. Direct Springer PDF endpoints were not recovered as readable artifacts. Exact-title and DOI searches led to ResearchGate, EconPapers, IDEAS/RePEc, and the Springer book table of contents; these candidates were rejected because they expose metadata, abstracts, references, or no-full-text notices, not the full technical source containing the problem statements.

No readable primary PDF or full HTML source was established. A source map was therefore limited to resolver metadata indicating a chapter in Commutative Algebra with three advertised topic areas: semi-effectivity, containment of symbolic powers in ordinary powers for fat point ideals, and splitting types of rank 2 bundles on rational curves.

Candidate extraction was not performed because the only readable material was resolver metadata, an abstract, landing-page metadata, references, and search snippets. Per the source adequacy and no-new-facts rules, those materials were not used as technical evidence for open-problem extraction.

Extraction stopped before accepted-question generation because no exact-work readable full-text source was recovered within the bounded recovery pass. Accepted output is empty and the run is marked for review with invalid_or_unreadable_input.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/7620546.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
